invariants.text: wine.wine_id must be a positive integer and auto-incremented
wine.name must be a non-null string and unique
wine.vintage_year must be a non-null integer
wine.country_of_origin must be a non-null string
wine.cost_price must be a non-negative integer
wine.selling_price must be a non-negative integer and strictly greater than wine.cost_price
wine.stock_quantity must be a non-negative integer
wine.primary_location_id must reference an existing StorageLocation
storage_location.location_id must be a positive integer and auto-incremented
storage_location.zone_name must be a non-null string
storage_location.row_number must be a non-null integer
storage_location.shelf_number must be a non-null integer
storage_location.max_bottle_capacity must be a positive integer
A wine's primary_location_id cannot be removed if wine.stock_quantity > 0
The total number of bottles assigned to a StorageLocation must not exceed max_bottle_capacity
